text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's ideas and techniques. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean, consistent, and easy to understand. Although reviews take extra effort, they are worth it. A strong review culture builds trust, improves communication, and produces better software for everyone.
